response.rationale: Both forms mean a person or organization that employs a worker. “Pemberi kerja” is a standard Indonesian term, while “majikan” is the ordinary Malaysian preference; the contrast is useful though Indonesian also uses “majikan,” especially for household employers.
response.risk_rationale: Register and context affect the Indonesian choice: “majikan” can suggest a household employer, whereas “pemberi kerja” is broader and more neutral.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: Indonesian also commonly uses “majikan,” particularly in domestic-work contexts, while Malaysian uses “pemberi kerja” in formal or institutional contexts. These alternatives do not erase the useful ordinary preference represented by the pair.
